# 🎃 TABLE PARTY's Halloween Update is here!

Celebrate Halloween in TABLE PARTY’s spooky new lobby, featuring festive decorations, Halloween-themed board games, and fun avatar accessories!
[media]
# Bring game night to life — now in Mixed Reality.

TABLE PARTY is a lively collection of **17 board and party games** made for playing together.

Now with Mixed Reality, you can place the game table in your own room, stay connected to your surroundings, and play naturally using **Hand Tracking**. Pick up cards, roll dice, move tokens, and interact with game pieces with your hands — no controllers required.

With **Shared Anchors**, friends in the same physical space can gather around the same virtual table and enjoy the game together.
[media]
# 17 base games included.

From familiar classics to quick party games and strategic head-to-head challenges, choose whatever fits the mood.

Play a relaxed round with friends, test your strategy against another player, or turn the table into a little friendly competition.

There’s always something different to play.
[media]

# A growing lineup of licensed board game DLC.

Discover licensed board game DLC that brings even more tabletop favorites into TABLE PARTY, with immersive experiences across VR and MR.
[media]

 📢 Gather your friends for a fully immersive tabletop experience. It’s time to Table Party!
 
**We’ll continue improving Table Party** with regular updates and refinements. Feel free to let us know your thoughts!
